cohort_notes.E003_corrected_replay: Corrected-replay E003 panels. Train, validation and test are separate frozen objects; the test panels are the 20,222-row corrected-replay panels.
cohort_notes.E005_core: E005 core panels at 1024 AA. These are the panels the E005 models trained and validated on. They are not the broken-pair evaluation panels.
cohort_notes.E005_primary: E005 broken-pair evaluation panels. Every row's right endpoint is shifted, positives included, and the shifted endpoint is recorded in broken_candidate_sequence_sha256. true_partner_sequence_sha256 keeps the original partner and is not what was scored.
cohort_notes.RBT_fully_random: Fully random legal-pair baseline. Distinct unordered pairs (X, Y) sampled with no anchor, which is a different construction from anchor-preserving Uniform (A, C).

note: All 44 frozen panels are distributed. Row order, labels and endpoint sequence hashes are preserved. Private source, exclusion-registry and universe hashes are removed. Sequence registry joins reconstruct released rows; this is not a regeneration of missing historical registry inputs.
